findings.title: Bulk notification policy changed recipient semantics

boundaries: This certifies one Deft API instance. Multi-instance Socket.IO fanout is not covered because the current server uses in-memory room and presence state.
Queue pressure uses deterministic no-op jobs to isolate dispatcher throughput and stale-job recovery. External AI-provider latency, quotas, and cost are not certified here.
Browser rendering is outside this backend/realtime load run; product UI has separate dogfood coverage.
Scratch harness correction: use actual login accessTokens required by current web-session auth; all original load volumes and budgets unchanged.
Scratch harness scope: attention projection proves notifications for the 60 explicitly seeded people; system accounts are measured separately, not mistaken for missing human deliveries.

Scratch harness correlation: durable attention proof selects only notification bodies with this run marker, excluding independent startup maintenance. Load volumes, exact fanout and release budgets unchanged.
